title: Maintenance and Repair Workers, General
description: Perform work involving the skills of two or more maintenance or craft occupations to keep machines, mechanical equipment, or the structure of a building in repair. Duties may involve pipe fitting; HVAC maintenance; insulating; welding; machining; carpentry; repairing electrical or mechanical equipment; installing, aligning, and balancing new equipment; and repairing buildings, floors, or stairs.

tasks.text: Perform routine maintenance, such as inspecting drives, motors, or belts, checking fluid levels, replacing filters, or doing other preventive maintenance actions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Mechanical component inspection requires hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical components of vehicles to identify problems.
Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Inspect, operate, or test machinery or equipment to diagnose machine malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.
Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Adjust functional parts of devices or control instruments, using hand tools, levels, plumb bobs, or straightedges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Repair machines, equipment, or structures, using tools such as hammers, hoists, saws, drills, wrenches, or equipment such as precision measuring instruments or electrical or electronic testing devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Basic equipment maintenance requires hands-on work

dwas.name: Perform basic equipment maintenance.
Repair structural components.

tasks.text: Order parts, supplies, or equipment from catalogs or suppliers.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Diagnose mechanical problems and determine how to correct them, checking blueprints, repair manuals, or parts catalogs, as necessary.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Technical reading for maintenance well handled

dwas.name: Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs.
Troubleshoot equipment or systems operation problems.

tasks.text: Design new equipment to aid in the repair or maintenance of machines, mechanical equipment, or building structures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI proposes configurations; engineer verifies physical constraints

dwas.name: Develop equipment or component configurations.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Assemble, install, or repair wiring, electrical or electronic components, pipe systems, plumbing, machinery, or equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on wiring repair in physical environment

dwas.name: Assemble electrical components, subsystems, or systems.
Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.
Repair electrical circuits or wiring.

tasks.text: Clean or lubricate shafts, bearings, gears, or other parts of machinery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Estimate costs to repair machinery, equipment, or building structures.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Labor/material cost estimation from rates

dwas.name: Estimate costs for labor or materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Align and balance new equipment after installation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical alignment of machinery requires hands

dwas.name: Align equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Record type and cost of maintenance or repair work.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Record parts and repair details from provided data

dwas.name: Record information about parts, materials or repair procedures.

tasks.text: Maintain or repair specialized equipment or machinery located in cafeterias, laundries, hospitals, stores, offices, or factories.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of machinery

dwas.name: Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Dismantle machines, equipment, or devices to access and remove defective parts, using hoists, cranes, hand tools, or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.
Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Plan and lay out repair work, using diagrams, drawings, blueprints, maintenance manuals, or schematic diagrams.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Procedure drafting aided; context-specific validation human

dwas.name: Plan work procedures.
Lay out work according to specifications.

tasks.text: Install equipment to improve the energy or operational efficiency of residential or commercial buildings.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — On-site HVAC installation requires hands-on trade work

dwas.name: Install energy-efficient heating, ventilation, or air conditioning (HVAC) equipment.

tasks.text: Set up and operate machine tools to repair or fabricate machine parts, jigs, fixtures, or tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Fabricate parts or components.

tasks.text: Perform general cleaning of buildings or properties.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas

dwas.name: Clean work areas.

tasks.text: Train or manage maintenance personnel or subcontractors.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Operational training requires live human delivery

dwas.name: Train others in operational procedures.
Supervise employees.

tasks.text: Fabricate or repair counters, benches, partitions, or other wooden structures, such as sheds or outbuildings.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Assembling structural components is hands-on

dwas.name: Assemble structural components.

tasks.text: Paint or repair roofs, windows, doors, floors, woodwork, plaster, drywall, or other parts of building structures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Painting surfaces is hands-on manual work

dwas.name: Paint surfaces or equipment.

tasks.text: Perform routine maintenance on boilers, such as replacing burners or hoses, installing replacement parts, or reinforcing structural weaknesses to ensure optimal boiler efficiency.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of machinery

dwas.name: Install machine or equipment replacement parts.
Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Provide groundskeeping services, such as landscaping or snow removal.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual snow removal with tools outdoors

dwas.name: Remove snow.
Perform manual agricultural, aquacultural, or horticultural tasks.

tasks.text: Operate cutting torches or welding equipment to cut or join metal parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual welding requires dexterity and live judgment

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect used parts to determine changes in dimensional requirements, using rules, calipers, micrometers, or other measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical distance measurement in field

dwas.name: Measure distances or dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Assemble boilers at installation sites, using tools such as levels, plumb bobs, hammers, torches, or other hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Position, attach, or blow insulating materials to prevent energy losses from buildings, pipes, or other structures or objects.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Insulation installation requires manual fitting

dwas.name: Install insulation in equipment or structures.

emerging_tasks.task: Use drones for inspecting roofs, gutters, and other hard-to-reach areas of buildings.
